title: storage: fix implicit directory sizes without relaxing mtime checks
body:
This PR is limited to the size fix. It preserves strict mtime checks and does not resolve the existing directory-mtime discrepancies.

English translation of the author's Chinese scope statement; translation assisted by AI.

```diff
-subdirectory = newCheckDirectory(uid, gid, size, mode, mtime)
+subdirectory = newCheckDirectory(uid, gid, 0, mode, mtime)
```

```text
Changeset entry: etc/nested/payload, regular file, size=7
Implicit directories: etc/ and etc/nested/
Expected directory sizes: 0
Expected file size: 7
```

```sh
go test -run '^TestImplicitDirectorySize$' ./storage
```
